life_history: Dylan is a 20-year-old college student referred for counseling following a recent citation for underage driving under the influence (DUI) and transport to a detox facility. He historically performed well academically, holding a 3.5 GPA in high school with aspirations of becoming an international journalist. Recently, his drinking behavior has escalated, causing him to sleep through morning classes and threatening his academic standing. The primary precipitants for counseling are university disciplinary action, his parents confiscating his vehicle, and the severe threat of academic suspension, which would force him to relocate to his uncle's farm in Iowa and isolate him from his peers.
intermediate_beliefs: Positive assumption: If I engage in drinking with my buddies, then I am just a normal college kid having fun and fitting in; negative assumption: If I stop drinking or get suspended, then my social life will be killed and I will be completely isolated.
intermediate_beliefs_during_depression: If I fail to reprioritize my education and get suspended, it proves I have ruined my future and will never achieve my dream of being an international journalist.
coping_strategies: Maladaptive coping strategies include binge drinking in response to frustration (e.g., his favorite football team losing), minimizing his problematic behavior by blaming bad luck and comparing himself to friends who do not get caught, and avoiding academic distress by sleeping through his 8:00 AM classes when hungover. Adaptive coping and harm-reduction plans discussed include confining his drinking to his apartment to eliminate the risk of driving, waiting until he is 21 to drink at parties, finding alternative social activities that do not revolve around alcohol, and focusing on his long-term career aspirations.

cognitive_models.situation: Watching the Vikings football game at a friend's house and the team starts losing significantly.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: The Vikings are losing pretty big, this is frustrating. I'm just a normal college kid hanging out with my buddies. I'll just drink a little bit more to deal with this.
cognitive_models.behavior: Drank more alcohol than originally intended.

cognitive_models.situation: Unable to find a ride home after drinking at the friend's house.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: I have to get home and my roommate can't pick me up. It wasn't a big house party, so it's fine. I will just drive myself.
cognitive_models.behavior: Drove his vehicle while under the influence of alcohol, leading to a DUI citation and detox.

cognitive_models.situation: Confronted by the counselor regarding the severity of his DUI citation and detox transport.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: I don't have a drinking problem, I have a getting caught problem. My friends drink like fishes and never get caught. I just got busted because of bad luck. It is unfair that I am the one in trouble.
cognitive_models.behavior: Downplayed the severity of his drinking, blamed external circumstances, and initially denied having a substance use problem.
